limitations: Artifact hashes establish internal consistency, not cryptographic proof of historical creation order or absence of undocumented outside calls.
Recorded model request and event usage cannot independently attest the actual remote model identity, backend compute time, or transport causal behavior.
Process seconds and preparation seconds are recorded client measurements; concurrent sums are not elapsed wall time or an equal-compute comparison.
Preparation time includes fitting plus serialization and is not a standalone fitting timer.
Only the locked parent-feature/response pools and source measurement definitions are inspected; no raw arrays, D/test, new strategy execution, or repeated gate/r4 mathematics audit.
Scientific scope remains one adaptive trajectory per task across two previously revealed families.
